_note: Source-grounded entry for EQUIDERMA AI. Unsupported fields are intentionally empty.
description: A chronic itchy skin disorder characterized by well-demarcated erythematous patches or plaques of thickened, leathery skin.
causes: Underlying itchy dermatoses or other causes of pruritus can contribute.
risk_factors: Atopic dermatitis, psoriasis, scabies or xerosis can contribute to secondary lichen simplex.
Heat, sweat, chemical irritants and insect bites can act as triggers.

appearance.general: Lichenified patches or plaques with accentuated skin markings.
appearance.dark_skin: Hyper- or hypopigmentation may be more prominent and erythema less obvious in darker skin.

doctor_discussion_points: Whether an underlying itchy disorder is present.
Whether biopsy, patch testing or fungal testing is required.
